summary.headline: Children and the Sixth House
summary.text: Discussion of astrological testimonies governing love or enmity between a native and their children, using the first, fifth, seventh, eighth, and twelfth houses and the lots of children and life. Chapter XXI begins an account of servants, subjects, captives, and the significations of the sixth house, including the sixth sign, its lord, benefics, malefics, the lot of captives, and Mercury.
